cards.title: MLB - Yankees
cards.recap: Yankees last played at home against Red Sox. The result was W 6-3 vs Red Sox (Sep 1). Winning pitcher: Carlos Rodon. Losing pitcher: Brayan Bello. Save: Clay Holmes. Yankees home runs: Aaron Judge and Anthony Volpe. New York broke a 3-3 tie with three runs in the seventh and eighth innings and closed it out with a clean ninth. Judge hit a two-run homer and Volpe added a solo shot. Current record: 82-57. Next: vs Blue Jays - Sep 3, 7:05 PM.

cards.title: NFL - Steelers
